subject: maths
question: Ranu can finish a piece of work in 10 days while Ruby can finish the same work in 15 days. In how many days the whole work will be finished. If they work on alternate days, starting with Ranu?
solution:
**Given Data:**

Ranu's work completion time = 10 days

Ruby's work completion time = 15 days

**Concept:** When two people work on alternate days, the total time taken is 2 × (LCM of individual times / sum of individual rates of work)

**Solution:**

⇒ Ranu's rate of work = 1/10 per day

⇒ Ruby's rate of work = 1/15 per day

⇒ LCM of 10 and 15 = 30

⇒ Total time taken = 2 × (30 / (1/10 + 1/15)) = 12 days

**Hence, the work will be finished in 12 days when Ranu and Ruby work on alternate days.**
